scope: Inventory of all committed v7 paths by top-level groups, with detailed hashes only for the selected engine, tests, oracles, drivers, build and documentation files.
not_a_claim: Counting and hashing files is not a line-by-line reading or a proof of correctness. Source hashes are not inherited qualification.
path_list_hash_protocol: SHA256 of lexicographically sorted UTF-8 repository-relative paths, each followed by one NUL byte; no opaque receipt paths expanded in this JSON.

manuscript.reading_scope_required: Parts I and II; file hash alone does not attest reading.

excluded_from_v8_delivery.policy: No v7 engine or receipt package is imported by this inventory; uncommitted v7 work and all unrelated dirty v6 files are preserved and excluded from the v8 audit delivery.
